rules: Do not force a repository merge before architecture/evidence supports it.
Incremental convergence is allowed and may happen feature by feature or domain by domain.
Preserve repository ownership boundaries until a specific responsibility is explicitly migrated.
Every migration step needs source repo, destination repo, scope, dependencies, evidence, rollback and owner decision where required.
Do not duplicate an implementation in the destination before the source responsibility is reconciled.
Cross-repo contracts may be centralized before source code is physically moved.
